v2-1768394248791-atkosh24t.name: Black Rock Desert
v2-1768394248791-atkosh24t.description: A vast, dry lakebed in Nevada known for its harsh desert environment and the annual Burning Man festival.

v2-1768394248791-3lft8mvej.name: Playa
v2-1768394248791-3lft8mvej.description: The central open space within Black Rock City where the main festival activities and art installations are located.

v2-1768394248791-8kblrkp8x.name: Neon-Lit Structure
v2-1768394248791-8kblrkp8x.description: A massive, ephemeral art installation on the playa, constructed from various materials and illuminated by a network of vibrant neon lights. It stands tall against the night sky, casting a colorful glow onto the dusty surroundings, often appearing in modular or geometric forms.

v2-1768394269574-h9a2y1wct.name: The Temple of Gratitude
v2-1768394269574-h9a2y1wct.description: An ephemeral art installation dedicated to collective appreciation. It is a space designed for reflection and shared positive sentiment, manifesting as a unique sculptural form on the playa.
forbiddenTransformations: The structure appearing as a permanent building.
The installation being indistinguishable from natural landscape elements.
The structure being depicted as overly organic or fluid.
The neon lights appearing dim or non-functional.
The playa environment being absent or overly lush.

v2-1768394269574-n4dyc03eh.name: Gratitude Chamber
v2-1768394269574-n4dyc03eh.description: You step into a chamber where the geometric steel frame of the structure continues inward, now acting as the walls of this space. The plywood panels and recycled components are treated to absorb and diffuse the vibrant neon light, creating an immersive, glowing environment. The air hums with a subtle, resonant energy.

banned: celestial bodies visible through the enclosure
heavy drapery or traditional temple motifs

promptLayers.background: The internal faces of the geometric steel frame, clad in treated plywood and recycled materials, form the walls. These surfaces glow with diffused light, appearing as continuous planes of soft, vibrant color. The 'ceiling' is an implied continuation of this geometric framework, largely obscured by the integrated lighting.
promptLayers.midground: The dominant feature is the internal structural geometry, creating angular alcoves and passages. The neon and LED lighting is integrated into this structure, casting an ambient glow rather than harsh lines. Subtle interactive elements or projections might be present, hinting at the theme of gratitude.
promptLayers.foreground: The floor is the same dusty playa material, subtly illuminated by the glow from above and the sides. Fine dust particles might catch the light, adding a shimmering quality to the immediate surroundings. The base of the steel structure is visible where it meets the ground.
promptLayers.lighting: The harsh neon exterior light is transformed into a pervasive, diffused glow emanating from the structure's internal surfaces. The primary colors of pink, electric blue, and lime green are present but softened and blended, creating an otherworldly luminescence that fills the space. Shadows are soft and form gentle, rounded edges rather than sharp lines.
promptLayers.atmosphere: The dazzling and surreal atmosphere of the exterior is internalized. The sense of being within a futuristic, artificial construct is amplified, fostering a feeling of immersive reflection and wonder. The intense artificial light and geometric forms combine to create a deeply contemplative yet vibrantly alive space.

forbiddenTransformations: The interior appearing as a standard room with furniture.
Visible sky through any gaps or openings.
Natural materials like wood or stone forming the primary surfaces.
The space feeling open or cavernous, rather than contained within the structure.
Any sign of the exterior desert landscape being directly visible.
The light becoming natural or white.
The neon tubes being visible as distinct, un-diffused elements on the interior surfaces.
